## Closeout

The task gives each tenant its own retry budget so that one tenant's
failing webhooks cannot exhaust the shared queue, and the work is complete
on revision 4f2c9a1. The essential gate was run with `codeflow test --mode
essential --strict` and passed with 412 tests, none failed and none
skipped, in 41.2 seconds. The retry_budget suite contributed 38 passing
tests, the tenant_clock suite 12 and the queue_isolation suite 9. Coverage
came out at 84.2 percent of statements over crates/queue and
crates/tenant, which is above the floor of 80 percent that AC-3 sets. A
tenant over budget is delayed rather than dropped, which meets AC-1. The
budget resets on the tenant's own clock, which meets AC-2. The Windows
path was not tested because no Windows runner is attached to this
repository. The queue isolation test ran against the in-memory queue and
not against Redis. All three acceptance criteria are therefore met and the
task can close.
